# Workspace management API

Manage tenant sites, team membership, rules, and integrations with authenticated workspace requests.

Source: [site documentation](https://web-production-c0739.up.railway.app/docs/workspace-api) · platform revision `4b7879729687067d55fe230a0503385b205c0018`.

<a id="sites"></a>

## Sites & policy

Management routes are relative to https://api-production-761a5.up.railway.app/api and use Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. Responses use the standard success/data/timestamp envelope. Owners manage sites; team roles and SAML site scope restrict access.

| Route | Operation |
| --- | --- |
| GET /sites | List accessible sites; SAML sessions return only their scoped workspace. |
| POST /sites | Create {name, domain, allowedOrigins?}; owner plan site cap applies. |
| GET /sites/{id} | Read a site you can access. |
| PATCH /sites/{id} | Owner updates name, domain, threshold, challengeMode, allowedOrigins, enabledRules. |
| POST /sites/{id}/rotate-keys | Owner rotates public and server keys immediately. |
| DELETE /sites/{id} | Owner deletes a site. Treat as a destructive operation. |

**POST /api/sites**

```json
{
  "name": "Shop production",
  "domain": "shop.example.com",
  "allowedOrigins": [
    "https://shop.example.com"
  ]
}
```

<a id="team"></a>

## Team membership

| Route | Operation |
| --- | --- |
| GET /platform/team?siteId=… | Owner reads workspace team. |
| POST /platform/team | Owner invites {siteId, email, role}; role is viewer or analyst. |
| DELETE /platform/team/{id} | Owner removes a membership. |

An invitation returns an inviteUrl and expiry. Share the invitation through your own approved channel. Invites expire after seven days; users must complete registration or acceptance before SSO can match their membership. A viewer can inspect permitted data but cannot perform analyst or owner mutations.

<a id="integrations"></a>

## Integration endpoints

| Capability | Routes | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rules | GET /rules?siteId=…; POST /rules; PATCH or DELETE /rules/{id} | Custom rules: Pro or Enterprise. |
| Rule field reference | GET /rules/suggestions | Authenticated session. |
| Webhooks | GET/PUT /webhooks?siteId=…; POST /webhooks/test?siteId=… | Owner; Pro or Enterprise. |
| SAML configuration | GET/PUT /auth/sso/{siteId}/config | Owner; Enterprise. |
| Plan catalog | GET /billing/plans | Public catalog. |

- [Webhook contracts](webhooks.md) — Receiver configuration and payloads.
- [SAML configuration](sso.md) — Identity-provider setup and sign-in requirements.
